   "source": [
    "# Generating Embeddings using Hugging Face (Free models)\n",
    "\n",
    "**Level:** Scratch → Intermediate\n",
    "**Runs on:** Google Colab (Free CPU/GPU)\n",
    "\n",
    "### What you will learn\n",
    "1. What an embedding is (in simple words)\n",
    "2. Installing free, open Hugging Face libraries\n",
    "3. Generating embeddings with `sentence-transformers`\n",
    "4. Comparing text similarity using cosine similarity\n",
    "5. Visualizing embeddings in 2D\n",
    "6. Building a mini Semantic Search engine (intermediate project)\n",
    "\n",
    "> No API key needed. No paid model used. Everything here runs on the free Hugging Face open-source models."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "59c7e4e0",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. What is an Embedding?\n",
    "\n",
    "- An **embedding** is a list of numbers (a vector) that represents the *meaning* of a piece of text.\n",
    "- Similar sentences → similar (close) vectors.\n",
    "- Different sentences → far apart vectors.\n",
    "\n",
    "Example:\n",
    "- \"I love dogs\" and \"I like puppies\" → vectors will be **close**\n",
    "- \"I love dogs\" and \"The stock market crashed\" → vectors will be **far apart**\n",
    "\n",
    "We will use the `sentence-transformers` library, which uses free Hugging Face models."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7963771b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

   "source": [
    "from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load the free pre-trained model from Hugging Face\n",
    "model = SentenceTransformer(\"all-MiniLM-L6-v2\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Model loaded successfully!\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8af6c01d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 4. Generate Your First Embedding"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

   "source": [
    "sentence = \"I love learning about Artificial Intelligence.\"\n",
    "\n",

    "print(\"Embedding shape:\", embedding.shape)\n",
    "print(\"First 10 values:\", embedding[:10])"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "396e8a27",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Discussion Point:** Notice the embedding has 384 numbers. These numbers don't mean anything individually — but together, they capture the *meaning* of the sentence."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5a8299b7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 5. Generate Embeddings for Multiple Sentences"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "31765e05",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Number of sentences: 5\n",
      "Embedding matrix shape: (5, 384)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sentences = [\n",
    "    \"I love dogs\",\n",
    "    \"I like puppies\",\n",
    "    \"The stock market crashed today\",\n",
    "    \"Cats are cute pets\",\n",
    "    \"The economy is in recession\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "embeddings = model.encode(sentences)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Number of sentences:\", len(sentences))\n",
    "print(\"Embedding matrix shape:\", embeddings.shape)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e25ea8a5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 6. Measure Similarity Between Sentences\n",
    "\n",
    "We use **Cosine Similarity** to check how close two embeddings are.\n",
    "- Score close to `1` → very similar meaning\n",
    "- Score close to `0` → unrelated meaning\n",
    "- Score close to `-1` → opposite meaning (rare with text)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity\n",
    "\n",
    "similarity_matrix = cosine_similarity(embeddings)\n",
    "\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "df = pd.DataFrame(similarity_matrix, index=sentences, columns=sentences)\n",
    "df.round(2)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4d8f85a8",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Important Discussion Point:**\n",
    "Look at the similarity score between *\"I love dogs\"* and *\"I like puppies\"* — it should be high.\n",
    "Compare that to *\"I love dogs\"* vs *\"The stock market crashed today\"* — it should be low.\n",
    "\n",
    "This is the **core idea behind semantic search, chatbots, and recommendation systems**."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4d930c91",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 7. Visualize Embeddings in 2D (using PCA)\n",
    "Embeddings have 384 dimensions — we can't see that. So we reduce it to 2D just to *visualize* how sentences cluster."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "08d91e6e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 700x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "pca = PCA(n_components=2)\n",
    "reduced = pca.fit_transform(embeddings)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "plt.scatter(reduced[:, 0], reduced[:, 1])\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, sent in enumerate(sentences):\n",
    "    plt.annotate(sent, (reduced[i, 0], reduced[i, 1]), fontsize=9)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.title(\"2D Visualization of Sentence Embeddings\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"PCA Dimension 1\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"PCA Dimension 2\")\n",
    "plt.grid(True)\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ca76ca77",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Discussion Point:** Sentences with similar meaning (dogs/puppies, stock/economy) should appear **closer together** in the plot, even though we never told the model to group them manually."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "98310c93",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 8. Intermediate Project: Mini Semantic Search Engine\n",
    "\n",
    "**Goal:** Given a user query, find the most relevant sentence from a small database — using meaning, not just matching words."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "24258cf3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Query: Tell me about AI and neural networks\n",
      "\n",
      "Score: 0.534  |  Deep learning uses neural networks with many layers.\n",
      "Score: 0.524  |  Python is a popular programming language for AI.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Our small \"document\" database\n",
    "documents = [\n",
    "    \"Python is a popular programming language for AI.\",\n",
    "    \"The weather today is sunny and warm.\",\n",
    "    \"Machine learning models learn patterns from data.\",\n",
    "    \"I enjoy playing football on weekends.\",\n",
    "    \"Deep learning uses neural networks with many layers.\",\n",
    "    \"Paris is the capital city of France.\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Encode all documents once\n",
    "doc_embeddings = model.encode(documents)\n",
    "\n",
    "def semantic_search(query, top_k=2):\n",
    "    query_embedding = model.encode([query])\n",
    "    scores = cosine_similarity(query_embedding, doc_embeddings)[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Rank documents by similarity score\n",
    "    ranked_idx = scores.argsort()[::-1][:top_k]\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"Query: {query}\\n\")\n",
    "    for idx in ranked_idx:\n",
    "        print(f\"Score: {scores[idx]:.3f}  |  {documents[idx]}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Try it\n",
    "semantic_search(\"Tell me about AI and neural networks\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "1ec4f9c8",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Query: What is the capital of France?\n",
      "\n",
      "Score: 0.824  |  Paris is the capital city of France.\n",
      "Score: 0.102  |  Python is a popular programming language for AI.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Try another query\n",
    "semantic_search(\"What is the capital of France?\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "36cff1d3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 9. Key Takeaways (Recap for Students)\n",
    "\n",
    "| Concept | Meaning |\n",
    "|---|---|\n",
    "| Embedding | Numeric vector representing meaning of text |\n",
    "| Model used | `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` (free, open-source, Hugging Face) |\n",
    "| Cosine Similarity | Measures how close two embeddings are |\n",
    "| Semantic Search | Finding relevant text by meaning, not exact words |\n",
    "| PCA | Used only to visualize high-dimension vectors in 2D |\n",
    "\n",
    "### 10. Practice Exercises (for students)\n",

    "def faq_bot(question):\n",
    "    question_embedding = model.encode([question])\n",
    "    \n",
    "    scores = cosine_similarity(question_embedding, faq_embeddings)[0]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    best_idx = scores.argmax()\n",
    "    \n",
    "    print(\"Question:\", question)\n",
    "    print(\"Answer:\", faq_answers[best_idx])\n",
    "    print(\"Similarity Score:\", round(scores[best_idx], 3))"
   ]
